source: Retained Q2 provider and frozen native C core only; no peer changes imported

findings.finding: C scheduler calls scalar decode for1 row, real lie_sequences_decode for multiple ready rows; flow credits choose eligibility.
ForwardBatch groups projections for1..8 sessions, retaining private recurrence/KV and async PLE reads. Shared weights can be reused by Q8 dense consumers.

ForwardBatch invokes eager body and then synchronizes; it does not use the scalar Forward HIP graph replay. A graph cache needs safe session/lifetime keys, descriptors, cancellation and split PLE handling.
SelectBatchLogits queues a separate D2H and synchronizes for each non-null logit destination; DecodeBatchImpl calls it per completed request.

Existing pinned logits buffer is sized for max_logit_rows, not the sum across sessions. Consolidating readback needs bounded batch staging and accounting, or a queue of separately owned destinations, not an unchecked larger copy.

priority: First measure actual current C1 waits and C2 batch/readback service. Consolidated batch readback is smaller than safe batch graph capture, but neither has a measured gain here.
